title.en: The Private Executioner - Murder Lawyer and the Scales of Themis

altTitles.ja: 私刑執行人〜殺人弁護士とテミスの天秤〜

altTitles.ja-ro: Shikkei Shikkoujin - Satsujin Bengoshi to Themis no Tenbin

altTitles.en: The Private Executioner - Murder Lawyer and Themis Balance

description.en: Do you believe in justice? Faced with horrific crimes, helpless victims break down in tears. Perpetrators go unpunished. Bereaved families go unrequited. What are human rights? What is justice? What is fairness? A single devil who governs the law will use all his brutality and abnormality before the hammer of justice falls! Kusashita Shinya, known as "Half-Gray" and "Gokuchu", and Uchida Kohei, known as "Kuroba Hakusho", form a powerful team. A terrifying comic about a murderous lawyer is now available. Are all human lives really equal?
description.ja: 第1巻の内容紹介: あなたは、裁判を信じますか？　凄惨な事件の前で、なすすべなく被害者は泣き崩れる。裁かれない加害者。報われない遺族。人権とは？正義とは？公平性とは？ 法を司る一人の悪魔が、暴虐と異常性の限りを尽くし裁きの鉄槌はくだされる！　「半グレ」「ごくちゅう」草下シンヤと「黒羽白書」内田康平、強力タッグ結成。戦慄の弁護士殺人鬼コミック、解禁。　人の命とは本当に平等なのか…―――。
